steps.en: Open the app on an Apple Silicon Mac (DMG, or build the frozen GPL source)
steps.zh: 在 Apple 芯片 Mac 上打开应用（DMG，或自编冻结的 GPL 源码）

steps.en: While open, serves a local MCP endpoint bound to localhost
steps.zh: 应用开着时，在本机回环地址上提供 MCP 端点

component.zh: 应用内 MCP HTTP 服务

steps.en: Register that endpoint with your coding agent
steps.zh: 把这个端点注册给你的编码 agent
steps.code: claude mcp add --transport http palmier-pro http://127.0.0.1:19789/mcp

steps.en: Ask the agent for an edit in plain words
steps.zh: 用大白话让 agent 改片子

steps.en: The agent calls editing tools that change the open timeline
steps.zh: agent 调用剪辑工具，直接改你开着的时间线

steps.en: Each agent edit lands in the same undo history as your own edits
steps.zh: agent 的每次改动和你手动的改动进同一条撤销历史

steps.en: Review on the timeline, undo or adjust, then export
steps.zh: 在时间线上检查，撤销或微调，然后导出

value.en: An agent edits the project you have open, instead of you re-expressing the cut as a script
value.zh: agent 直接改你开着的工程，不用把剪辑再翻译成一份脚本
